info.description: The Payments Webhooks API enables businesses to receive real-time notifications for various payment events, such as successful transactions, failures, or refunds. This API is crucial for ensuring that systems are updated promptly with payment status changes, allowing for immediate action and improved customer experience. Typical consumers include payment processors, e-commerce platforms, and financial service providers who require automatic alerts for payment-related activities. By utilizing this API, organizations can effectively streamline their payment workflows and enhance transaction handling.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to access the payment webhook details, which are crucial for managing payment notifications. Use this to ensure you are updated with the latest payment events.

requestBody.description: This endpoint receives a webhook notification related to payment events. The payload should include specific details about the payment status and identifiers as defined by the schema.
